interpretation: The prior compressed artifact is not retained, so exact decompressed-payload identity across the transition cannot be proved retrospectively. The current payload is bound above, and canonical numerical products and decisions are invariant. Byte-level immutability across the two gzip versions is not claimed.
future_compression_policy: Any regenerated gzip must use a deterministic header (mtime=0 and no source filename), must publish both compressed and decompressed SHA-256 values, and must receive a new manifest version rather than silently replacing an existing hash.
